title: Replay re-admits scientific authority, in two readers that share no code for it
note: The store's replay and snapshot restore re-decide each scientific_result admission under the policy the transition names, with origin bound to the governed tasks that captured the report and the bundle; the independent reader decides it again in its own code. SA mutates the store, the policy dispatch and the origin view; RX mutates the second reader; GR21-GR22 are reuse's admission and origin-now filters.
